tools.name: validate_tax_number
tools.description: Validates the check digit of a 10-digit Turkish tax identification number (Vergi Kimlik Numarası, VKN) used by companies. Format and checksum only: a valid result does not prove the number is registered or belongs to anyone. Inputs are not stored or logged.

tools.name: validate_national_id
